subject: Initial tenant access: API key seeding & admin roles
messages:
From: Jake Reynolds <jake.reynolds@novacorp.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@novacorp.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Initial tenant access: API key seeding & admin roles

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. We want to get the tenant live next week; before that we need a clear plan for: API key creation (service vs. user keys), admin role assignment for our security team, and a simple project layout to separate prod/test.

Quick questions:
- Can you seed a pair of service keys scoped to a single project so our infra team can smoke test?
- We need role names to pre-create in our SSO so provisioning is smooth.
- Any recommended TTL/rotation cadence for seeded keys before we switch to our vault?

I can share the SSO contact if that helps. Attaching our initial inventory.

Thanks,
Jake

Attachment: novacorp_inventory_v0.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Jake Reynolds <jake.reynolds@novacorp.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@novacorp.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 17:28:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Initial tenant access: API key seeding & admin roles

Hi Jake — great to connect, and thanks for the inventory. Below is a short, executable plan we can run this week. If you approve, Monica (CS) will execute the tenant-side invites and Dev will seed the first keys for your infra test.

Plan (high level):
1) Project & scoping
   - Recommend two projects: "novacorp-prod" and "novacorp-staging" (isolates quotas & logs).
2) Roles (names to mirror in your SSO)
   - admin
   - billing_viewer
   - app_deployer
   - infra_service (for seeded service keys)
3) API key seeding (temporary)
   - We will create two service keys scoped to novacorp-staging with infra_service role and a 7-day TTL.
   - Keys delivered over DocuSign/secure link; plan to rotate into your vault by day 5.
4) Invites & SSO mapping
   - Provide the SAML group names you plan to map to the Redwood roles; we will send invite links that auto-map when matched.
5) Audit & logs
   - Enable token-exchange logging for the first 48 hours so we can confirm calls and KV cache behavior.

Attachments: novacorp_initial_roles.csv (text/csv), novacorp_api_key_seed_plan.pdf (application/pdf)

Next steps / ask:
- Approve the project and role names above (reply with any tweaks).
- Confirm SSO group names for auto-mapping (or say if you prefer manual assignment).
- Confirm an ETA for when infra can accept the seeded keys (we'll schedule delivery window).

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 20:05:00 -0500
Subject: [CS Handoff] NovaCorp: seed keys & role mapping notes

Irene / Dev — looping in the engineering handoff details for execution. I took notes from the onboarding call and added a couple of operational safeguards.

Handoff items:
- Project naming: use the "novacorp-staging" prefix for seeded keys to avoid accidentally granting prod quota.
- Seeded keys: two service keys, each scoped to the infra_service role; mark them as "ephemeral" (7-day TTL).
- SSO mapping: ask NovaCorp to create groups exactly named: "novacorp_admins", "novacorp_billing", "novacorp_deployers". We'll map those to Redwood roles admin, billing_viewer, app_deployer.
- Vaulting: schedule automatic rotation reminder on day 4 and final revocation on day 7 unless they confirm vault ingestion.
- Audit: enable debug-level request logging for the seeded keys for the first 48 hours and share logs to the secure drive link.

Operational links & references:
- Internal runbook: https://internal.redwood.com/runbooks/tenant-seed (internal)
- HubSpot: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/DEAL-8732

Attachments included for customer: novacorp_initial_roles.csv, novacorp_api_key_seed_plan.pdf

If Dev can seed tomorrow AM (PST) let's confirm window; otherwise propose Tue 10:00 PST.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
